_doc: Kelly, Kentucky. The 1955 case: on the night of 21 August 1955 the Lacy family (the game's name for the real family, whose name collides with the Office) held their farmhouse on US-41 against small glowing-eyed figures until dawn, then drove to Hopkinsville for the police. In August 1994 the team arrives for the 39th anniversary: three short days in Hopkinsville, the US-41 route, Kelly Crossroads, the Farm and the Pennyrile Sinks, then one long night holding the house. Hidden truth: natural (owls, a drunk, a family that believed itself), which the game never states; every verdict has real evidence. This is the combat case: fights on the route and in the Sinks, and the siege of the farmhouse is its lair. District content lives in data/cases/kelly/*.json; the siege is run from the `siege` table below by a prop with "use": "siege" on the Farm.
name: Kelly

observations.text: Small figures, three feet, silver, with glowing yellow eyes
Big ears, long arms, hands up like they were surrendering
They floated down out of the trees
Shotgun pellets did nothing; they rolled up and ran off
Nobody saw more than two at once
A light came down in the gully behind the house first
The whole family was drinking, the neighbours said
A travelling show lost a monkey that week

net_bundle.text: Forty feet of knotted net. Dale has ideas.

salt_sack.name: A sack of rock salt
salt_sack.text: Fifty pounds. For the doorsteps, Vera says, and she does not say why.

sweet_tea.name: Sweet tea, a quart
sweet_tea.text: Restores Composure. It is mostly sugar.

burgoo.name: Burgoo
burgoo.text: A stew of everything. Restores Composure and settles Dread a little.

owl_call.text: A wooden call from the pawn shop. +1 Intuition.

cayce_reading.text: A photocopied trance reading from 1931. +1 Intuition, and the Lore voice listens.

tobacco_coat.name: A tobacco hand's canvas coat
tobacco_coat.text: Smells of smoke and August. +1 Grit, +6 Composure.

kelly_pellet.name: A 1955 shotgun pellet
kelly_pellet.text: Dug from a porch post. Takes a charm slot. +2 Grit.

kelly_eye.name: A glass eye, yellow
kelly_eye.text: Found where no glass eye should be. Takes a charm slot. +2 Intuition.

roof_walker_photo.title: Photo: the shape on the roof ridge
roof_walker_photo.text: First grey light. For one frame it is a shape and not a shadow: short, long-armed, hands up. The next frame is a chimney.

roof_walker_tape.title: Tape: something on the tin
roof_walker_tape.text: A scrape on the roof tin every four seconds, a pause, then faster. June says a great horned owl walking on tin would do it. She does not say it twice.

roof_walker_gait.title: The way it walked
roof_walker_gait.text: It walked the ridge the way the account said, and the account changed four times tonight. It walked the way the last version said.

flashback_porch.title: The account changed: the porch
flashback_porch.text: In the first telling the shooting started on the porch. In the second it started in the kitchen, and the porch came later, after the first drink.

flashback_eyes.title: The account changed: the eyes
flashback_eyes.text: First telling: the eyes glowed. Second telling: the eyes shone, in the flashlight. Those are different things and the family stopped saying the second one.

flashback_count.title: The account changed: how many
flashback_count.text: Twelve or fifteen, the family told the police. Nobody in the house tonight ever saw more than two at once.

flashback_light.title: The account kept one thing
flashback_light.text: Every telling begins the same way: a light came down into the gully behind the house, before any of it. That part never changed, in four tellings, in 39 years.

lull_field_photo.title: Photo: the field at two in the morning
lull_field_photo.text: The tobacco field in the lull, by flash. Nothing in it. And in the far rows, where nothing is, the plants are bent toward the house.

siege_held.title: The house held until dawn
siege_held.text: Whatever came, the house held, the family's way: lamps, boards, salt and nerve, from dusk to first light.

siege.name: The siege of the farmhouse
intro: Dusk on the anniversary. The cousin left the key and would not stay. The tobacco barns are smoking down the road and the gully behind the house is already dark.
Four ways in: the gully, the treeline, the barn and the well. The signs you logged say which ones they will use. What you brought says which ones you can shut.

prep.done: Lamp light fills the gully. Nothing likes to be seen.

prep.text: String the net along the treeline
prep.done: Forty feet of knotted net between the oaks, at the height of a small man.

prep.text: Board the windows on the barn side
prep.done: The barn-side windows are boards now. The house is darker and smaller.

prep.text: Salt the doorsteps on the well side
prep.done: A line of rock salt across every sill on the well side. Vera walks it twice.

waves.text: Full dark. The first of them comes up out of the gully, and it has its hands up.

lines: Between the waves, the house tells the night the way the family told it, in 1955, to the police at two in the morning.
"We were on the porch. The dog went under the house. Then the first one came up the gully with its hands up, and Billy Ray shot it off the fence and it rolled up and ran."
flashback.question: Something is different from the way the cousin tells it. What?

waves.text: Two of them in the treeline, and one of them is not touching the ground.

lines: "Their eyes glowed. Yellow. We shined the light on them and the eyes shone back like a cat's."
flashback.question: Which word did the family stop using after the first night?

waves.text: Eyeshine in the barn rafters, and then the eyes are at the window.

lines: "There were twelve or fifteen of them. All over the yard. On the roof."
The room is quiet. Nobody in it tonight has seen more than two at once.
flashback.question: What does the count tell you?
options: That they saw the same two, over and over

waves.text: The tall one fills the well-side window frame. It is the little man, if the little man were as tall as the door.

lines: "Before any of it, before supper, a light came down in the gully behind the house. Round. It went down slow and we never saw it again."
Four tellings tonight. That part has not moved a word in 39 years.
flashback.question: What is the one thing that never changed?

lull.text: Two in the morning. Nothing. The real night had this gap too; the family drove to town in it. The field is out there, and it is quiet, and the camera is on the table.

out.text: Step outside and photograph the field
out.intro: The flash goes off over the tobacco and something answers it.

stay.text: Stay in the house and wait for it
stay.done: You wait. The clock in the kitchen stopped years ago and you can still hear it.

intro: First grey light. Something walks the roof ridge above you, and the shingles do not creak.
Up the attic ladder, out the gable. The whole county is grey and the thing on the ridge turns to look at you.
final.win: The sun comes up over the Pennyrile and there is nothing on the roof but you. Down in the kitchen somebody has started coffee.
final.lose: You come down the ladder when the sun is up. Nobody asks what you saw.
